intro.title: Card grid with auto-fit
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a responsive card grid that automatically adjusts the number of columns based on the available screen width. You will learn to use the CSS Grid property `grid-template-columns` with the `repeat()` function and the `auto-fit` keyword. This involves creating a container element, defining grid items, and applying styles for layout and appearance. By the end, you'll understand how to create flexible, modern web layouts that work on various device sizes using pure CSS.
intro.usecase: Auto-fit grids are essential for creating responsive product galleries, dashboards, and content feeds that adapt to different screen sizes. You'll see this pattern in e-commerce sites like Amazon where product cards rearrange themselves to fill available space without awkward gaps. Developer dashboards like GitHub Projects or analytics tools use auto-fit to display cards, widgets, or metrics panels that automatically adjust as you resize the browser. This technique ensures optimal space utilization while maintaining consistent gutters, making it perfect for any card-based layout that needs to be fluid and responsive.
